name: STC-224XGDGE.docx
path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial Ethernet Switch/STC-224XGDGE.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It adopts high-quality and high-speed network intelligent chip and completely solves the noise problem of small switches in the office environment through the fan-less mute design
This switch has 24*2.5G RJ45 ports and 2*10G SFP port enjoying
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M/2.5G Ethernet
easy to manage and maintain
It can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
24*2.5G RJ45 ports+2*10G SFP ports
Comply with IEEE 802.3, IEEE802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3bz,  IEEE 802.3ae, IEEE 802.3x
Ethernet ports support 10/100/1000M/2.5G self-adaptive
Support port Auto MDI/MDIX
Panel indicator lights monitor working status and help failure analysis
Flow control mode, full duplex adopts IEEE802.3x standard, half duplex adopts Back pressure standard
Surge Protection: General 6KV, Differential 2KV(level C), ESD 8KV air, 6KV contact(level C)
Specification
Product Name	26 Port Hybrid Rate Ethernet Switch
Port	24*2.5G RJ45 Ports(Support MDI/MDIX, auto-sensing) / 2*10G SFP Ports
Switching Capacity	160Gbps
Throughput	119.04Mpps
MAC Address	16K
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network Protocol	IEEE802.3(Ethernet) / IEEE802.3u(Fast Ethernet) / IEEE802.3ab(Gigabit Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3bz(5G Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3z(Gigabit Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3ae(10G Ethernet) / IEEE802.3x(Flow control)
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15, CISPR(EN55032)class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2(ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP/STP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP/STP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP/STP(≤100m) / 2.5GBase-T: Cat5 or above UTP/STP(≤100m) / 5GBase-T: Cat6 or above UTP/STP(≤100m) / 10GBase-T: Cat6 or above UTP/STP(≤100m)
Optical Medium	Multi mode: 50/125, 62.5/125, 100/140um / Single mode: 8/125, 8.7/125, 9/125, 10/125um
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Input Voltage	AC 100-240V, Single Power Input / Internal DC 12V4A Converter
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / 1-24 Port Network Light / Green on: 2.5G Link connect normal / Yellow on: 10/100/1000M Link connect normal / Off: Link off / Flashing: data transmitting / 25-26 Port Green Light / On: 10G Link connect normal / Off: Link off / Flashing: Data transmitting / SM / The default speed of the optical port is 10G/2.5G, which changes to 10G/1G after pressing the switch button / Dialing / On: VLAN mode is enabled(ports 1-22 are isolated and communicate with ports 23-26 of the uplink) / Off: VLAN mode is off(all ports communicate with each other)
Dimension
Remark
Please contact us if the source file is needed
Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 440*205*44mm
Inner box size: 500*290*85mm
Product weight: 2.61Kg
Packing weight: 3.12Kg
Master box size: 520*445*310mm
Packing quantity: 5Pcs
Packing weight: 16.6Kg
Remark
Accessories(optical module, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power cable is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing

Remark
